'''2019 Endor Grand Prix''' was a Players Committee major event, January 2019. [[Jonny Chu]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-endor-grand-prix/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' United States
* '''Dates:''' January 2019
